blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Event-based cameras provide high temporal resolution, low power consumption, and a high dynamic range, but progress in event-based object detection remains constrained by the scarcity of annotated training data. To solve this issue, this paper introduces the tool UnrealEvent, a synthetic dataset-generation pipeline implemented in Unreal Engine 5.5. The pipeline combines a V2E-inspired event-frame generator with EasySynth semantic-rendering passes, allowing rendered level sequences to be converted into paired event representations and YOLO-format bounding-box annotations without manual labeling. Events are generated from per-pixel log-luminance differences between consecutive frames, with contrast thresholds sampled independently from a normal distribution to emulate the fabrication-induced threshold mismatch of real sensors. Using this pipeline, we provide a synthetic dataset and evaluate YOLOv8 detectors under synthetic, zero-shot real, and real fine-tuning training on eTraM. The results show strong in-domain synthetic performance but a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, especially for pedestrians. Fine-tuning on a small real subset improves real-domain performance, while the remaining gap highlights the importance of asset diversity and sensor calibration.
blocks.zh: 基于事件相机提供高时间分辨率,低功耗,高动态范围,但基于事件物体检测的进展仍受附加说明的训练数据稀缺所制约. 为了解决这个问题,本文引入了UnrealEvent这一工具,即由Unreal Engine 5.5所执行的合成数据集生成管道. 管道结合了一款由V2E启发的事件帧生成器和EasySynth语义-递接通道,可以将已实现的等位序列转换成对等的事件表示和YOLO格式的边框说明而无需手动作标签. 事件是由相接相框之间的每像素日志发光差异所产生,对比阈值从正常分布中独立抽取,以模仿由制造引起的真实传感器的阈值不匹配. 利用这个管道,我们提供了一个合成数据集,并评价了YOLOv8探测器在合成,零发真实,真实的微调eTraM上的培训. 结果显示,域内合成性能很强,但合成与实际差距很大,对行人来说尤其如此。 细化一个小的真子集可以改善实域性能,而所剩空白凸显出资产多样性和传感器校正的重要性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Object detection is a fundamental task in computer vision, aiming to identify objects of interest in images and estimate their spatial properties such as position, scale, and orientation. Driven by advances in sensing, algorithms, and computing, it has been adopted across automation, surveillance, wildlife conservation, and healthcare [ 20 ] . Most of this progress, however, relies on conventional frame-based cameras, which sample the entire scene at fixed temporal intervals. Despite their effectiveness, frame-based sensors suffer from high latency, limited dynamic range, high power consumption, and motion blur when capturing fast-moving objects, limitations that are especially problematic in dynamic or resource-constrained settings [ 5 ] . Event-based cameras, also known as neuromorphic vision sensors, have emerged as an alternative inspired by the biological visual system. Rather than acquiring full frames synchronously, each pixel operates independently and asynchronously, generating an event only when its local change in luminance exceeds a threshold. This paradigm yields very high temporal resolution without motion blur, a sparse and data-efficient stream with correspondingly low bandwidth and power requirements, and a high dynamic range achieved by responding to logarithmic intensity changes. Consequently, event cameras remain robust in challenging conditions such as nighttime scenes or abrupt illumination changes where conventional sensors often fail [ 6 ] . Despite these advantages, the adoption of event-based vision remains limited, largely due to the scarcity of large-scale, well-annotated datasets. Neuromorphic sensors are costly, and remain confined to specialized research communities [ 2 ] , so publicly available event-based datasets are at least an order of magnitude scarcer than their frame-based counterparts. The asynchronous, discrete nature of event data further complicates its integration into standard learning pipelines, typically requiring conversion into frame-like representations that may discard fine-grained temporal information [ 25 , 23 ] . Event-based dataset creation also inherits the general difficulty of capturing target objects under diverse illumination, environmental, and safety-critical conditions, making the process logistically complex and expensive. These factors have motivated a shift toward synthetic data generation as a scalable and controlled alternative [ 14 ] . Synthetic data preserves the underlying structure of real-world data while enabling large-scale generation without specialized hardware, eliminating the safety concerns of recording hazardous scenarios [ 7 ] and avoiding privacy issues since no real individuals or locations are captured [ 11 ] . Such data is typically produced with rendering engines such as Blender or Unreal Engine (UE), or dedicated simulators such as ESIM [ 24 ] , DAVIS [ 18 ] , and V2E [ 12 ] . UE is particularly attractive for its near-photorealistic output and its support for interactive navigation and camera trajectory control, enabling flexible and repeatable data generation, albeit at higher computational cost [ 24 ] . Motivated by the dataset scarcity that constrains event-based object detection, this work investigates synthetic data generation within simulation environments. Specifically, we address three research questions: (1) how an Unreal Engine pipeline can generate event-like visual representations and synchronized annotations; (2) how a synthetically trained event-based object detection model generalizes to real-world data; and (3) how an automated pipeline can be built to generate annotated data. In doing so, we aim to contribute to more accessible and scalable methods for event-based dataset creation.
blocks.zh: 物体探测是计算机视觉中的一项基本任务,目的是确定对图像感兴趣的物体并估计其空间特性,如位置、尺度和取向等。 在感知、算法和计算进步的推动下,它被采用,跨越了自动化、监视、野生生物养护和保健[20]。 然而,这一进展大多依赖于传统的帧相机,它们以固定的时间间隔对全场进行取样. 帧式传感器尽管有效,但在捕捉快动物体时却有高耐久性、有限动态范围、高功耗和运动模糊等困难,这些限制在动态或资源受限的环境下尤其有问题[5]。 基于事件的相机,也叫神经形态视觉传感器,已经作为一种被生物视觉系统所启发的替代物而出现. 每个像素不是同步获得全帧,而是独立和同步地运行,只有在其局部亮度变化超过阈值时才会生成一个事件. 这种范式产生非常高的时空分辨率而无运动模糊,零散而有数据效率的流,相应的带宽和动力要求也很低,并且通过响应对数强度变化而实现了高动态范围. 因此,在诸如夜间场景等具有挑战性的条件下,或者在常规传感器经常故障的突然发光变化中,事件相机仍然很坚固。 尽管有这些优势,但采用基于事件的愿景仍然有限,这主要是由于缺乏大规模、精心说明的数据集。 神经形态传感器费用高昂,而且仍然局限于专门研究社区[2],因此公开的基于事件的数据组至少比基于帧的对应数据少出数量级. 事件数据的同步和离散性质进一步使其与标准学习管道的结合复杂化,通常需要转换成类似帧的表示,从而可能丢弃精细的时间信息[25,23]. 基于事件的数据集创建也继承了在不同照明、环境和安全关键条件下捕获目标物体的一般困难,使这一过程在后勤上复杂而昂贵。 这些因素促使人们转向合成数据生成,将其作为可伸缩和受控制的替代[14]。 合成数据保留了现实世界数据的基本结构,同时使得没有专门硬件的大规模生成成为可能,消除了记录危险情景的安全隐患[7]并避免了隐私问题,因为没有真实的个人或地点被捕获[11]. 此类数据一般由Blender或不真实引擎(UE)等渲染引擎产生,或由ESIM [24],DAVIS [18],和V2E [12]等专用模拟器产生. UE尤其具有吸引力,因为它的近相现实性输出以及支持交互式导航和相机轨迹控制,使得数据生成具有灵活性和可重复性,尽管计算成本较高[24]. 受限制基于事件对象检测的数据集稀缺的驱动,本作在模拟环境下调查了合成数据生成. 具体来说,我们处理三个研究问题:(1)一个不真实的引擎管如何产生类似事件的视觉表现和同步说明;(2)一个经过合成训练的事件对象检测模型如何概括到现实世界的数据;和(3)如何建造自动管来生成附加说明的数据. 在这样做时,我们的目标是促进建立基于事件的数据集的更方便和可扩展的方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Event Data Simulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 事件数据模拟

blocks.en: Table 1 : Overview of simulators
blocks.zh: 表1:模拟器概览

blocks.en: Because real event data is costly to acquire, simulation has become a central tool for generating event streams under controlled, repeatable conditions. The DAVIS simulator [ 18 ] was among the first, rendering a virtual scene along a predefined camera trajectory with Blender and reconstructing event timings through linear temporal interpolation, under the constraint that inter-frame motion stays below one third of a pixel. While effective as an initial step, it models only an idealized pixel and omits the sensor noise present in physical cameras. ESIM [ 24 ] advanced this by tightly coupling the simulator to the rendering engine and adaptively adjusting the sampling rate to the dynamics of the visual signal, yielding more faithful event timing. It also introduced a standard noise model motivated by the observation that the contrast threshold varies approximately according to a normal distribution. Residual discrepancies nonetheless remain, as simple noise models do not capture effects such as missed events during the pixel refractory period at high event rates [ 3 ] . Subsequent simulators target more realistic, non-ideal behavior. V2E [ 12 ] operates directly on conventional RGB video rather than a 3D scene, modeling pixel-level Gaussian threshold mismatch, finite intensity-dependent bandwidth, intensity-dependent noise, and motion-blur effects, making it well suited to converting existing frame-based recordings into events. DVS-Voltmeter [ 17 ] grounds event generation in sensor physics, jointly modeling circuit voltage variations, the stochastic nature of photon reception, and temperature- and parasitic-current-induced noise [ 19 ] as stochastic processes. More recently, V2CE [ 34 ] improves timestamp recovery from event voxels via local dynamics-aware inference, reporting substantially lower error and event counts much closer to real sensors than prior video-to-event methods. Table 1 summarizes these simulators. Despite steady gains in realism, all of these simulators share one limitation relevant to dataset creation: they produce event streams but no annotations. This restricts their direct use for training supervised models such as object detectors, and motivates coupling event simulation with automatic annotation, which is the focus of this work.
blocks.zh: 由于真实的事件数据成本昂贵,模拟已经成为在可控可重复条件下生成事件流的中心工具. DAVIS模拟器 [18] 属于第一种,通过线性时间插值,将预定义相机轨迹上与Blender一起做成虚拟场景并重建出事件时间,其限制是帧间运动保持在像素的三分之一以下. 它虽然作为起步有效,但只模拟一个理想化的像素并省去物理相机中存在的传感器噪声. ESIM [24]通过紧密地将模拟器与渲染引擎相接并适应地将采样速率与视觉信号的动态相适应来推进这一点,产生更忠实的事件时间. 它还引入了标准噪声模型,其动机是观察到对比阈值因正常分布而大致不同. 尽管如此,剩余差异依然存在,因为简单的噪声模型无法捕捉到像素折射期以高事件率发生的错失事件等效应[3]. 随后的模拟器以更现实,更非理想的行为为目标. V2E [12] 直接在常规的RGB视频上运行,而不是3D场景,模拟像素级高斯阈值不匹配,受限强度依赖带宽,受强度依赖的噪音,和运动-blur效应,使其非常适合将现有的基于帧的录音转换为事件. DVS-Voltmeter [17] 传感器物理学中的地面事件生成,联合建模电路电压变化,光子接收的分层性质,以及温度和寄生电流引起的噪音[19]作为分层过程. 最近,V2CE[34]通过当地动态-认知推论改进了事件花序图的恢复,报告误差和事件数量大大低于以往的视频-事件方法,更接近真实传感器。 表1概述了这些模拟器。 尽管在现实主义上取得了稳步的进展,但所有这些模拟器都有一个与数据集创建相关的限制:它们产生出事件流但没有说明. 这限制了它们直接用于训练受监督的模型,如物体探测器,并激励将事件模拟与自动注释相配合,这是这项工作的重点.

blocks.en: 2.2 Event-Based Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于事件的数据集

blocks.en: High-quality datasets are a prerequisite for training and benchmarking event-based vision models, yet they remain scarce relative to datasets for frame-based vision. Real-world datasets are captured with physical event cameras: MVSEC [ 36 ] provides stereo sequences with depth and pose ground truth from fused IMU, LiDAR, motion-capture, and GPS; DSEC [ 10 ] targets autonomous driving with LiDAR-derived depth refined through mapping; and EventVOT [ 30 ] and eTraM [ 29 ] use high-definition Prophesee sensors for tracking and traffic monitoring, with professionally annotated bounding boxes. Such datasets achieve high realism but are expensive and logistically demanding to produce, requiring extensive recording across conditions and costly manual or professional annotation. A recurring theme across these datasets is that annotation is method-specific and tightly bound to the acquisition setup: MVSEC and DSEC rely on LiDAR and GPS for depth ground truth, SeACT [ 35 ] uses GPT-4 to generate textual action descriptions, the Yelan synthetic dataset [ 33 ] derives joint keypoints from its underlying Blender models, and SEVD [ 1 ] uses CARLA’s bounding-box API. SEVD is the closest prior work to ours, being the first synthetic event dataset to use multiple event sensors in CARLA [ 9 ] with automatically generated 2D and 3D bounding boxes. However, CARLA is built specifically for autonomous-driving research, so SEVD inherits that scope and offers limited flexibility for other object categories or environments. This constraint motivates a general-purpose, annotation-aware pipeline that is not tied to a single application domain.
blocks.zh: 高质量的数据集是培训和确定基于事件的设想模型的基准的先决条件,但相对于基于框架的设想数据集而言,它们仍然很少。 真实世界数据集被物理事件相机所捕获:MVSEC [36] 提供了有深度的立体序列,并且从被熔化的IMU,LiDAR,动作捕捉和GPS中呈现出地面真实性;DSEC [10] 目标自主驾驶,通过绘图精炼出LiDAR衍生出深度;以及EventVOT [30]和eTraM [29] 使用高清晰的预言传感器进行跟踪和交通监测,并配有专业说明的边框. 这种数据集具有很高的现实性,但费用昂贵,在后勤上要求很高,需要广泛记录各种情况,并需要花费大量人工或专业说明。 这些数据集反复出现的一个主题是:注解是方法上的特异性,与获取设置紧密相接:MVSEC和DSEC依靠LiDAR和GPS来获取深度地心真伪,SeACT [35]使用GPT-4来生成文字动作描述,Yelan合成数据集 [33]从其基础Blender模型中得出了联合键点,SEVD [1]使用CARLA的受限框 API. SEVD是之前最接近我们的作品,是第一个使用CARLA [9] 中多个事件传感器的合成事件数据集,自动生成了2D和3D边框. 然而,CARLA是专门为自主驾驶研究而建造的,因此SEVD继承了这个范围,并为其他对象类别或环境提供了有限的灵活性. 这种限制促使一个通用的、有注释意识的管道与一个单一的应用领域不挂钩。

blocks.en: 2.3 Unreal Engine for Computer Vision
blocks.zh: 2.3 计算机视野的不真实引擎

blocks.en: Unreal Engine (UE) has become a widely used platform for synthetic data generation, owing to its high-performance, near-photorealistic rendering pipeline, which helps narrow the gap between real and synthetic data for training and evaluation [ 32 ] . Several tools build on UE to support computer vision (CV) workflows. UnrealCV was the first open-source plugin to connect UE to CV pipelines, exposing ground truth such as bounding boxes, depth maps, and segmentation masks, and enabling systematic generation of annotated image datasets [ 22 ] . UnrealGT extends this to object-detection datasets, pairing image outputs (RGB, depth, semantic and instance segmentation, normals) with camera metadata to produce annotations automatically. ReplicANT [ 21 ] places 3D models into procedurally generated, configurable UE 5 environments and exports annotations for detection, tracking, pose estimation, and segmentation, while the Falling Things dataset [ 28 ] uses a custom UE plugin to generate photorealistic images with pixel-accurate 2D/3D bounding boxes and segmentation masks. These tools demonstrate that UE supports automatic, high-quality annotation for conventional frame-based vision. At the same time, ESIM [ 24 ] shows that UE can serve as a rendering backend for event simulation, but it provides no annotation capability. To our knowledge, no existing tool generates fully annotated event-based datasets within UE. This gap directly motivates our work: a simulation pipeline that converts rendered RGB video sequences into event representations while simultaneously producing synchronized bounding-box annotations, transferred from the semantic frames to the event data.
blocks.zh: 非真实引擎(UE)因其高性能,近相可视渲染管道而成为了合成数据生成被广泛使用的一个平台,有助于缩小用于培训和评价的真实和合成数据之间的差距 [32]. 一些工具基于UE支持计算机视觉(CV)工作流程. UnrealCV是首个将UE连接到CV管道的开源插件,揭示了边界箱,深度地图等地面真相和分块口罩,并使得能系统生成注释图像数据集[22]. UnrealGT将它延伸至对象检测数据集,将图像输出(RGB,深度,语义和实例分割,常态)与相机元数据对齐,自动生成说明. 复制 [21] 将3D模型放入程序生成,可配置的UE 5环境和导出说明用于检测,跟踪,平面估计和分块,而"倒地物"数据集 [28] 则使用自定义的UE插件来生成光现实化图像,并有像素精确的2D/3D边框和分块口罩. 这些工具表明,UE支持对以常规帧为基础的视觉进行自动,高质量的注释. 同时,ESIM [24] 显示UE可以作为事件模拟的渲染后端,但它没有提供注释能力. 据我们所知,没有任何现有工具在UE内生成充分附加说明的事件数据集。 这一缺口直接激发了我们的工作:一个模拟管道,将 RGB 视频序列转换为事件表示,同时产生同步的绑定框说明,从语义框架转移到事件数据.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Simulation Environment
blocks.zh: 3.1 模拟环境

blocks.en: The pipeline is built in UE 5.5, chosen for its photorealistic rendering and its compatibility with the open-source EasySynth plugin [ 31 ] , which renders annotation passes (semantic segmentation, depth, surface normals) from level sequences and supports custom post-processing effects. This extensibility lets us integrate the event-camera effect developed in this work directly into EasySynth’s rendering, so that event frames and ground-truth labels are produced from the same scene. Vehicle and pedestrian assets were sourced from the Fab marketplace [ 4 , 26 , 15 ] for visual diversity. Level sequences are rendered at 300 fps; this high rate is essential, since faithful event simulation requires dense temporal sampling between frames, and it lets UE render directly at the target rate without the Super-SloMo interpolation that V2E applies to low-frame-rate video. The rate of 300 fps balances temporal fidelity against rendering time, as higher rates increase the frame count and thus generation cost.
blocks.zh: 管线以UE 5.5为构筑,取自其光现实化渲染及其与开源EasySynth插件相容性[31],该插件从等位序列中使注释通过(语义分出,深度,表面常态)并支持自定义后处理效果. 这种可扩展性让我们将本作中开发出的事件-相机效应直接整合到EasySynth的渲染中,从而将事件帧和地上真实的标签从同一场景中产生出. 车辆和行人资产来自Fab市场[4、26、15],用于视觉多样性。 水平序列在300英尺/秒时得到渲染;这种高速率至关重要,因为忠实事件模拟需要在帧间进行密集的时间采样,它让UE直接以目标速率得到渲染而无需使用超斯洛莫插值,即V2E适用于低帧率视频. 300英尺的速率平衡了时间忠贞度与渲染时间,因为较高的速率增加了帧数并从而增加了生成成本.

blocks.en: 3.2 Event Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 事件生成

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Full simulation pipeline
blocks.zh: 图1:全面模拟管道

blocks.en: The event-generation model is a V2E-inspired event-frame approximation adapted to operate on rendered frames inside UE. We deliberately adopt a rule-based rather than learning-based formulation: learning-based simulators such as EventGAN require paired event–image data that is itself scarce, and training on synthetic-only data yields a synthetic-to-synthetic domain gap with no guaranteed real-world transfer; moreover, the microsecond resolution of physical sensors is incompatible with the fixed render rates of game engines. A rule-based pipeline is therefore the more appropriate foundation, and the full pipeline is shown in Fig 1 . Each rendered frame is first converted to luminance, Y = 0.2126 ⋅ R + 0.7152 ⋅ G + 0.0722 ⋅ B . Y=0.2126\cdot R+0.7152\cdot G+0.0722\cdot B. (1) and then mapped to the log-luminance domain L = log ⁡ Y L=\log Y , reflecting the logarithmic response that gives event cameras their high dynamic range. The core stage, implemented as a post-processing material operating on two consecutive log-luminance frames, computes the per-pixel temporal difference Δ ​ L = L t − L t − 1 \Delta L=L_{t}-L_{t-1} . An ON (positive) event is assigned where Δ ​ L > 0 \Delta L>0 and an OFF (negative) event where Δ ​ L < 0 \Delta L<0 . An event is emitted only if its magnitude exceeds a per-pixel contrast threshold; otherwise no event is written at that location for the current frame. Fig. 2 shows an example of this output alongside its source RGB scene. The nominal value C nominal = 0.3 C_{\text{nominal}}=0.3 , which was used during testing, matches the V2E default and sits near the midpoint of typical sensor thresholds [ 12 , 8 ] ; it is exposed as a parameter so the pipeline can be tuned to a target sensor.

blocks.en: 3.3 Sensor Noise
blocks.zh: 3.3 传感器噪声

blocks.en: Two noise sources are modeled. Shot noise, arising from the quantal nature of photon arrival, is generated as ON/OFF events via a Poisson process consistent with V2E. Leak events are spontaneous ON events caused by junction leakage and parasitic photocurrent in the change-detector reset circuitry. Noise is applied after event generation and overrides any event previously written at the affected pixel. The full V2E noise model was not reproduced: the present implementation is a proof of concept aimed at validating the pipeline rather than maximizing fidelity, and additional effects such as the refractory period and hot pixels are left to future work.
blocks.zh: 两个噪声源被建模. 从光子到来时的四分法性质产生的闪出噪声,通过与V2E一致的Poisson过程作为ON/OFF事件产生. 漏出事件是改变-探测器重置电路中由相交道口渗出和寄生光电流所引发的自发事件. 噪声在事件生成后被应用,并覆盖先前在受影响的像素上写入的任何事件. 完整的V2E噪声模型没有被复制:目前的实施是概念的证明,旨在验证管道,而不是使忠诚最大化,再生期和热像素等额外效果留待未来工作.

blocks.en: 3.4 Automated Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.4 自动注释

blocks.en: The simulation components are packaged as a custom UE plugin, EventCamSimulation, which encapsulates the event-camera effect, its supporting materials and buffers, and three C++ modules implementing contrast-threshold sampling, leak events, and shot noise. A single manager actor placed in the scene drives the pipeline autonomously at runtime. EasySynth serves as the rendering backend and is the key to automated labeling: for each level sequence it renders, frame-by-frame, a paired DVS-style event frame (via the custom post-processing slot), a semantic-segmentation image, and an RGB frame, all written with identical filenames.
blocks.zh: 模拟组件被包装为自定义的UE插件"事件模拟"(EventCamSimulation),它封装了事件-相机效应,其辅助材料和缓冲,以及三个C++模块执行对比-阈值采样,泄漏事件和相片噪声. 现场安置的一位单一经理演员在运行时间自主地驱动管道. EasySynth作为渲染后端,是自动标签的关键: 对于它所制作的每个关卡序列,逐帧,一个对齐的DVS类事件帧(通过自定义后处理槽),一个语义分解图像,以及一个RGB框架,都用相同的文件名来书写.

blocks.en: Annotation is then fully automated. A script pairs each event frame with its segmentation image by filename and remaps the event channels to the eTraM convention for compatibility with the eTraM detector. A second script extracts labels from the segmentation images using OpenCV: pixels are mapped to classes via the known class–color map, connected components per class are identified, and their axis-aligned bounding boxes are computed and converted to the normalized YOLO format, producing one label file per frame. The result is a fully paired event dataset with bounding-box annotations, generated without manual labeling. This is our central contribution: any UE level sequence can be converted into an annotated event dataset.
blocks.zh: 然后,注释完全自动化。 一个脚本用文件名将每个事件框架及其分块图像对齐,并将事件通道映射到eTraM公约,以与eTraM探测器相容. 第二个脚本从使用 OpenCV 的分块图像中提取标签:像素通过已知的类-颜色图被映射到类中,每个类中连接的组件被识别出,它们的轴相接的边框被计算出并转换为正态的YOLO格式,每个帧产生一个标签文件. 结果是一个完全对齐的事件数据集,并带有边框说明,生成时不需要手动标签. 这是我们的中心贡献:任何UE级别序列都可以被转换成附加说明的事件数据集.

blocks.en: 3.5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.5 实验设置

blocks.en: To illustrate the pipeline, 19 19 level sequences were constructed ( 7 7 pedestrian-only, 5 5 vehicle-only, 7 7 mixed), each targeting a specific detection challenge: object scale (pedestrian traversals at distances of 30 30 , 15 15 , and 5 5 m), motion speed, frontal versus rear appearance, partial occlusion, closely spaced and crossing instances, multi-class scenes with overlapping pedestrians and vehicles, ego-motion from a vehicle-mounted camera, and static elevated viewpoints. Night-time variants were produced by adjusting UE lighting (sun time, reduced sky/directional intensity, moonlight-blue tint) to test robustness across illumination changes. Together these form the UnrealEvent dataset, comprising 50,692 50{,}692 annotated event frames ( 34,013 34{,}013 day, 16,679 16{,}679 night). The roughly 2 : 1 2:1 day-to-night ratio is deliberate, exposing the detector to varied lighting conditions that are especially relevant for event sensors operating on a logarithmic intensity scale.

blocks.en: The labeled synthetic data trains a YOLOv8 detector using the architecture established by eTraM for event-based detection, for 20 20 epochs at batch size 64 64 . Generalization is assessed by evaluating the synthetically trained model on the real-world eTraM test set. All experiments are run with three random seeds and reported as mean ± \pm std; the primary metric is per-class AP50, matching the convention of the eTraM baseline, and all real-data evaluations use the validation-selected checkpoint.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the pipeline in three regimes, all summarized in Table 2 : the model trained and tested on synthetic data; the same model applied zero-shot to the real eTraM test set; and the model after fine-tuning on a small real subset. The synthetic row is measured on the synthetic test set; all others are measured on the full static test split of eTraM ( 30 30 sequences; 110,224 110{,}224 frames at a 33 33 ms accumulation window). Detection performance is reported as per-class AP50 (average precision at IoU 0.5 0.5 ), the same metric as eTraM’s published baseline.

blocks.en: 4.1 Performance on Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 合成数据的性能

blocks.en: On the synthetic test set, which was 15 % 15\% of the generated data, the model reaches an AP50 of 0.991 ± 0.002 0.991{\pm}0.002 for vehicles and 0.888 ± 0.009 0.888{\pm}0.009 for pedestrians. The residual errors are missed detections rather than misclassifications: at the validation operating point, 97 % 97\% of vehicles but only 79 % 79\% of pedestrians are recovered, with the remainder assigned to background. This pattern is consistent with the sparse, edge-and-motion nature of event data, which provides less discriminative signal than dense frames, especially for small or partially occluded objects. The detections the model does make are reliable, qualitative examples carry confidence scores of 0.84 − 0.96 0.84-0.96 with accurate localization, confirming that the limitation is recall, not classification or localization. Vehicles outperform pedestrians across every metric, for two reinforcing reasons. First, vehicles occupy larger image regions and thus generate denser, more spatially coherent event patterns than pedestrians, who may span only a few pixels. Second, and more subtly, the training set carries a 2.55 : 1 2.55:1 vehicle-to-pedestrian instance imbalance despite more pedestrian sequences being authored. This is a consequence of the sensing modality itself: because event cameras respond only to luminance change, slow-moving pedestrians at walking speed produce too few contrast changes to register consistently across accumulated frames, yielding far fewer valid annotated instances per sequence than vehicles. The imbalance is therefore an emergent property of event-based data, not a labeling artifact.
blocks.zh: 在合成测试组上,该模型达到0.991±0.002=0.991=pm}车辆0.002和0.888±0.009。 0.888{\pm}0.009 为行人. 余下出错为失检而非错分类:在验证操作点,97%的97\%车辆被取回,但只有79%的79\%行人被取回,其余被分配到背景. 这种模式符合事件数据所呈现的稀少,边缘和运动性质,它们提供的区别信号比密集帧要少,对于小或部分被占用的物体尤其如此. 该模型确实作出的检测是可靠的,定性的例子携带了0.84−0.96 0.84-0.96的置信分数,精确的本地化,证实了限制是召回的,而不是分类或本地化. 由于两个强化原因,车辆在每一公尺范围内的行人表现都超过行人。 首先,车辆占据了更大的图像区域,从而产生比行人更密集,空间更连贯的事件模式,行人可能仅能跨出几像素. 第二,而且更巧妙地说,培训集载有2.55:1 2.55:1 车辆对行车的场景不平衡,尽管更多的行人序列被写出. 这是感应方式本身的后果:因为事件相机只响应光亮变化,行走速度缓慢的行人产生的对比变化太少,无法在累积框架之间一致登记,因此每个序列的有效附加说明实例远远少于车辆。 因此,这种不平衡是基于事件的数据的新兴属性,而不是标注文物。

blocks.en: 4.2 Zero-Shot Generalization to eTraM
blocks.zh: 4.2 将 " 零热 " 化为 " 电子旅游 "

blocks.en: If the synthetically trained model is directly applied to real eTraM data, performance drops sharply, to an AP50 of 0.074 ± 0.010 0.074{\pm}0.010 for vehicles and 0.059 ± 0.019 0.059{\pm}0.019 for pedestrians, with the model missing roughly 90 % 90\% of pedestrians and 87 % 87\% of vehicles. This result exposes a substantial sim-to-real domain gap, a well-documented obstacle in event-based vision [ 13 , 27 ] : synthetic event streams differ from real recordings in event density, noise statistics, and scene complexity.
blocks.zh: 如果合成训练过的模型被直接应用于真实的eTraM数据,性能会急剧下降,车辆的AP50为0.074±0.010 0.074±pm}0.010,行人为0.059±0.019±pm}0.019,而该模型大约缺失了90%的行人和87%的车辆. 这一结果暴露出一个实质性的线性与现实域间差距,这是基于事件的愿景中一个有充分记载的障碍[13,27]: 合成事件流在事件密度,噪音统计和场景复杂性方面与真实录音不同.

blocks.en: Zero-shot transfer fails almost completely for both classes. After adapting the detector to the target domain, however, a concrete limitation of the synthetic data becomes apparent (Sec. 5.3): vehicles, which were rendered from six distinct models, recover much more of their performance after fine-tuning than pedestrians. In contrast, all pedestrian instances were generated from a single skeletal mesh with a default appearance, as shown in Fig. 3 . As a result, the model was never exposed to the appearance and motion variability characteristic of real pedestrians. This suggests that limited asset diversity is an important constraint on pedestrian generalization.
blocks.zh: 两班的零发转会几乎完全失败. 然而,在根据目标域调整了探测器后,合成数据的具体限制变得明显(第5.3节):车辆从6个不同的型号中提供,在微调后比行人恢复了更多的性能. 相比之下,所有行人例都是由一个有默认外观的单个骨骼网所产生,如图3所示. 因此,该模型从未暴露出真实行人外观和运动可变性特征. 这表明有限的资产多样性是限制行人通俗化的重要因素.

blocks.en: Importantly, the qualitative results are more promising than the aggregate metrics alone would suggest. When the zero-shot model produces detections, they are typically assigned high confidence scores in the range of 0.55 0.55 to 0.93 0.93 for vehicles and 0.63 0.63 – 0.70 0.70 for the sparse pedestrian detections, and are accompanied by spatially well-aligned bounding boxes. This indicates that the pipeline learns localization cues that transfer to some extent across domains, but remains poorly calibrated to the noise profile and accumulation characteristics of the target sensor.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,质量结果比总体衡量标准更有希望。 当"零射"型号产生探测时,一般会给它们分配高度的置信分数,车辆为0.55 0.55到0.93 0.93,行人探测为0.63 0.63 – 0.70 0.70,并伴有空间相通的相接相接箱. 这表明管道学习了局部化的提示,这些提示在某种程度上跨越了各个域,但仍无法很好地适应目标传感器的噪声特征和积累特征。

blocks.en: 4.3 Fine-Tuning on a Small Real Subset
blocks.zh: 4.3 小型真实子集的微调

blocks.en:
To adapt the detector to the target domain, we fine-tuned the synthetic-trained model on 2,436 2{,}436 randomly selected eTraM training images spanning day and night, freezing the backbone so that synthetic-learned features are retained while the detection head adapts to the real distribution. Fine-tuning runs for a fixed 300 300 -epoch budget and we report the validation-selected checkpoint.
This improves real-domain performance: vehicle AP50 rises from 0.074 0.074 to 0.606 ± 0.017 0.606{\pm}0.017 and pedestrian AP50 from 0.059 0.059 to 0.356 ± 0.012 0.356{\pm}0.012 , a 6-8x improvement over zero-shot, with the residual class gap consistent with the single-mesh limitation identified above. Qualitatively, predicted boxes align closely with ground truth and enclose vehicles with minimal offset; the main remaining defect is occasional duplicate boxes, again a recall-side rather than localization issue.
These results show that a small amount of real fine-tuning data substantially narrows the sim-to-real gap. However, the controlled comparison in Table 3 indicates that this recovery is driven chiefly by the real data itself: with the real-data budget held fixed, initializing from the synthetic model performs on par with (full fine-tune) or slightly below (frozen backbone) training from scratch. The clearest paths to further improvement are more diverse pedestrian assets, a larger fine-tuning subset, and event-specific domain-adaptation methods. Representative results for the fine-tuned model are shown in Fig. 4 .

为了使探测器适应目标域,我们微调了2,436 2{,}436上随机选取的eTraM训练图像,昼夜穿行,冻结了主干线,这样在探测头适应真实分布的同时保留了合成学习的特性. 微调300个世纪的预算 我们报告验收的检查站

blocks.en: 5 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 未来工作

blocks.en: The pipeline was deliberately scoped as a proof of concept, using a stock UE 5.5 plugin to exercise the full generation, annotation, and evaluation workflow. This design made it possible to measure the remaining sim-to-real factors before addressing them through additional engineering. The controlled evaluation above suggests a clear ordering of future extensions by expected impact. Given that the fine-tuned pedestrian gap can be traced largely to the use of a single skeletal mesh, the most consequential improvement is greater asset diversity, including multiple pedestrian and vehicle models with varied appearance and motion. This directly targets the dominant source of sim-to-real error identified in our experiments. On the sensor side, the noise model can be extended beyond shot noise and leak events to include hot pixels and the refractory period [ 12 , 19 , 13 ] , both of which narrow the gap to physical sensors. Three further changes would broaden usability: making the output resolution configurable through a single parameter, so synthetic data can match a target sensor such as the Prophesee EVK4-HD ( 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 ) used by eTraM; exporting events in standard neuromorphic formats (AER, HDF5) rather than only image-based frames, preserving full temporal resolution for compatibility with established benchmarks; and making the temporal accumulation window adjustable, enabling denser representations aligned with the accumulation parameters of target datasets. Together these changes would let the pipeline produce data more closely matched to specific real-world sensors and processing frameworks.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work presented UnrealEvent, a synthetic dataset generation and annotation pipeline for event-based vision built in UE 5.5. Addressing the research questions posed in the beginning: the pipeline generates high-quality annotated event data by coupling a custom V2E-style event effect with EasySynth’s semantic rendering, from which bounding boxes are extracted automatically, so that any UE level sequence can be turned into a labeled event dataset without manual annotation. On generalization, a model trained predominantly on synthetic data and fine-tuned on a small real subset reaches an AP50 of 0.606 0.606 for vehicles and 0.356 0.356 for pedestrians on real eTraM data.
blocks.zh: 这项工作展示了UE 5.5所构建的以事件为基础的远景的合成数据集生成和注释管道。 解决开头提出的研究问题:管道通过将自定义的V2E型事件效果与EasySynth的语义渲染相配合,生成高质量的附加说明的事件数据,从中自动取出边框,这样任何UE级序列都可以被转换成标注的事件数据集而无需手动注释. 在一般化方面,一个主要接受合成数据培训的模型,对一个小真正的子集进行了微调,在真正的eTraM数据上,汽车的AP50达到0.606 0.606,行人达到0.356 0.356。

blocks.en: Rather than leaving the residual sim-to-real gap as a black box, the pipeline makes it measurable: because generation, annotation, and evaluation form a single controlled loop, individual factors can be isolated. The controlled comparison shows that, at the current level of event realism, synthetic pre-training does not yet yield a measurable benefit over training from scratch on the same real-data budget. This limitation appears to be caused by the specific assets and sensor parameters supplied to the pipeline, rather than from the generation-and-annotation approach itself. We then provides an evidence-ranked roadmap for improvement.
blocks.zh: 输油管与其把剩余的sim-to-Real ship作为黑匣子留下来,不如让它可以衡量:因为生成,注释,评价形成一个单一的控制循环,单个因素可以被孤立. 受控比较表明,在目前的事件现实主义水平上,合成预训尚不能比同一实际数据预算从零开始的培训产生可衡量的效益。 这种限制似乎是由向管道提供的具体资产和传感器参数造成的,而不是由生成和通知方法本身造成的。 然后,我们提供了一份按证据排列的改进路线图。

blocks.en: The principal practical cost is the UE expertise required to author diverse scenes; in return, the approach incurs no acquisition hardware cost, enables scenarios that are unsafe or difficult to capture physically, and scales through fully automated annotation. UnrealEvent therefore provides both a practical platform for controlled synthetic event-data generation and the measurement loop needed to close the gap it quantifies.
blocks.zh: 主要的实用成本是编写各种场景所需的UE专门知识;作为回报,该方法不产生购置硬件费用,使得无法安全或难以实际捕捉的场景,并通过完全自动化的注释来缩放规模。 因此,不真实的Event既为控制下合成事件数据生成提供了一个实用平台,也提供了缩小其量化差距所需的测量回路.
